answer: The nadir index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the glacier queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 145 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the oasis. Honest users pay that once, farms 9 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
